description: Master Plan Unified V202 formalizes the physical assembly, robust power and compute architecture, and software baselines for the Monkey-Head-Project. It details the Huey V4 shell assembly utilizing a wood speaker-base, a metal Thermaltake Mozart midrange, and a wood top capped with an animatronic head and hand. The physical finish is a latex-based silver over primer. It establishes the compute core as an Intel Core i9-12900K on an ASUS TUF Gaming Z790-Plus WiFi motherboard, powered by dual Corsair RM1000x PSUs, housing four Nvidia Tesla V100 32GB GPUs for 128GB of VRAM. It strictly targets a Python 3.13 ecosystem with 3.12 side-carding support, and confirms the Lenovo Legion Go as dedicated LabTech.

explicit_decisions: The project is organized around Huey Brain, Huey Body, and Huey Farm.
Huey V4 physical shell assembly merges the V3 physical base with V2 donor material.
V4 physical structure is three-tiered: a wood base salvaged from a speaker project (with robust wheels and speakers), a metal midrange utilizing the Thermaltake Mozart case, and a wood top.
V4 physical cap features the plastic animatronic monkey head and an attached animatronic hand for coding purposes.
V4 physical finish scheme: primer base followed by a latex-based silver color coat that dries with a rubber-like texture; clear coat has been abandoned.
Primary project storage consists of two 10 TB hard drives configured in a RAID 1 array for data redundancy.
Huey Brain core workstation hardware is confirmed as an ASUS TUF Gaming Z790-Plus WiFi motherboard paired with an Intel Core i9-12900K processor.
Lenovo Legion Go is strictly dedicated LabTech / support hardware, completely excluded from Huey Brain, Body, and Farm core runtime execution.
Four Nvidia Tesla V100 32 GB GPUs will be pooled to provide 128 GB of VRAM for large-model hosting (e.g., gpt-oss-120b).
A fifth discrete graphics card provides display output and system boot graphics.
PCIe risers are utilized to connect the accelerator cards to the motherboard.
Power delivery relies on dual Corsair RM1000x PSUs linked via an Add2PSU adapter.
Cooling relies on provisional air exchange for the shell transition; the external Canadian winter heat exchange is paused.
The target canonical Python namespace is hueyos, explicitly supporting Python 3.13, with Python 3.12 packages side-carded for PyGPT compatibility.
All references to third-party Atlas continuity support and the V1 MP3 fixture proof have been removed to preserve strict project canon.
Nexus controller implementations are strictly experimental, terminal-based, and subject to removal.
Only Dylan L.R. Pollock may lock project canon.
source_priority: older plans, transcripts, and archives as lineage
source_basis.inheritance_policy: Carry forward previous implementation evidence and lineage unless Unified V202 explicitly changes the direction. Do not present target-state decisions as already implemented.

truth_model.definition: Observed hardware, merged code, working commands, and directly verified behavior.
Architecture Dylan has selected for implementation, even when migration is incomplete.
A working selection that remains replaceable through evidence.
A decision intentionally left open pending additional detail or testing.
A longer-term capability whose implementation depends on resources, maturity, or later validation.
Earlier systems and decisions retained for continuity without overriding current direction.

canon.rule: No agent, tool, contributor, generated document, branch, or pull request may independently lock canon.
acceptance_mechanisms: Dylan intentionally merges a designated canonical update
canon.conflict_rule: Current explicit decisions override older documentation; implementation reality must still be labelled separately from accepted direction.

three_part_architecture.decision: Organize the system around Huey Brain, Huey Body, and Huey Farm.

current_platform.system: ASUS TUF Gaming Z790-Plus WiFi motherboard with Intel Core i9-12900K processor
current_platform.housing: Thermaltake Mozart case (midrange of V4 shell)
current_platform.purpose: Primary workstation, orchestration hub, and execution platform for Huey Brain
current_platform.storage: Two 10 TB hard drives in RAID 1 array for redundant project data storage

huey_body.current_boundary: V4 physical shell assembly is a three-tiered structure. The base is wood salvaged from a speaker project featuring robust wheels. The midrange is the metal Thermaltake Mozart case. The top is wood, capped with a plastic animatronic monkey head and an animatronic hand. The exterior finish is primer coated with a latex-based silver paint.
huey_body.integration_rule: Brain and Body integration requires explicit interfaces, operator-visible state, safe-stop behavior, and recovery procedures.

huey_farm.role: Scalable compute, model, storage, and support infrastructure.
huey_farm.planning_scale: 128 GB pooled local VRAM across four Nvidia Tesla V100 32 GB GPUs to comfortably host 120B/128B open-source models.
huey_farm.power_delivery: Dual Corsair RM1000x PSUs linked via Add2PSU adapter for stable, high-capacity load distribution.

unresolved_boundaries: Where canonical memory, models, logs, and state reside
Whether Huey identity spans all three parts or is embodied authoritatively by Brain

hardware_direction.architecture_baseline: Intel Core i9-12900K on ASUS TUF Gaming Z790-Plus WiFi inside Thermaltake Mozart case

storage_architecture.primary_pool: Two 10 TB 3.5-inch hard drives configured in RAID 1 array for redundant long-term project storage.

cooling_and_safety.transition_cooling: Provisional air exchange to facilitate the rapid standing up of the physical shell.
cooling_and_safety.target_cooling: External heat exchange utilizing Canadian winters (currently paused pending physical shell completion).

model_assumption.normal: large models (120B/128B OSS) operating on 128 GB pooled VRAM

pyhuey_and_python.accepted_role: Primary GUI and core runtime component
pyhuey_and_python.compatibility_environment: Python 3.12 packages side-carded to support PyGPT operations where necessary.
direction: Move primary operator workflows into PyHuey.
Retain a recovery-capable CLI for diagnostics and automation.

cognition_provider.rule: Use the API or local provider that best fits the task and architecture; do not bind the system prematurely to one provider.

logging.rule: Preserve all useful operational information while excluding secrets and unnecessary private data.
